title: Integrating multi-dimensional prosthodontic features into an interpretable XGBoost framework for cross-sectional diagnostic classification of peri-implant diseases.
summary: An interpretable XGBoost model classified peri-implant disease from clinical and prosthodontic features. A patient-split internal holdout reported 78.9% accuracy and AUC 0.821; the source notes external validation is needed and discusses label-leakage concerns.
organization: Not stated in the abstract reviewed

evidence.tested: Retrospective patient-split holdout evaluation reported 78.9% accuracy and AUC 0.821.
evidence.unknown: No external validation; retrospective classification does not establish clinical utility, and label leakage is an explicit limitation.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
